text:
Alex: Heads-up — publish pipeline just opened a regen diff that caused a minor semver bump for js-sdk. CI shows typegen changes only, no API surface changes. Anyone know why this is considered a minor?
Priya: Ugh, saw the alert. Looks like example ordering in the OpenAPI spec changed (examples block moved). typegen picks that up as a change in generated docs, but our semver rules should ignore docs-only diffs. :thinking_face:
Sam: Pasting failing snippet from CI: 
```
Error: New typegen output differs
diff --git a/clients/js/src/index.ts b/clients/js/src/index.ts
@@ -12,6 +12,8 @@
+  // example: userFlow v2
   export function createClient() {}
```
CI job id: 842713 - rerun failed.
ci-bot: Build #842713 failed on step "regen-check". Link: https://ci.redwood/842713. Tests: typegen-regressions.
Maya: This is the same noise we've seen when examples reorder. We added an examples normalizer in the spec linter but maybe the pipeline doesn't run it before typegen. Could be a timing/order-of-ops in the publishflow.
Jordan: If it's only examples, we should update the regen check to run `openapi-normalize --strip-examples` (or equivalent) before typegen, or add a flag to typegen to ignore example-only deltas. Both require a small patch.
Priya: Can confirm locally that running `scripts/normalize-openapi.js` then `yarn typegen` makes the diff disappear. Probably race where CI runs typegen against an unnormalized spec.
devex-bot: Created issue #7621: "typegen: example-order changes cause spurious semver bump in js-sdk" and assigned to @Priya and @Sam. CI job annotated.
Alex: OK — actionable plan: 1) hotfix CI to normalize specs before typegen (Sam), 2) add a typegen guard to treat example-only diffs as docs (Priya), 3) revert the accidental publish if the release already rolled (Maya). I'll file the release rollback if the publish went through.
Sam: I'll open a quick PR to run the normalizer as a step in the publishflow and add a unit test that reorders an example to ensure no diff. ETA a couple hours.
Priya: I'll scope the typegen change so it only relaxes semver for example-only changes (no surface/type changes). Will reference #7621 in the PR.
Maya: If anyone sees downstream sample-app flakes related to auth/retry (we had a flaky test in samples after last minor bump), flag them here. Might be unrelated but good to keep eyes on it.
Alex: Thanks — please ping @dev-oncall if the rollback is needed. :thumbsup:
